newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end up on debut, active secondaries.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end up on debut, active secondaries.

text.p: The debut of fisheries firm Daya Guna Samudra and active buying of some secondaries pushed up the Jakarta index slightly on Thursday despite falls in some few big-capitalised stocks, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index rose 0.03 points, or 0.01 percent, to close at 575.89 points after touching an intra-day low of 574.54 points.
Brokers said the market was likely to continue being mixed on Friday as investors were mostly trading on a short-term basis in anticipation of next month's listing of Bank Negara Indonesia 1946.
